title: A tampered authoritative blob is detected and retained

pins.section: ## 8. Reading content: integrity, tamper and derived caches

onDisk.sources/sha256/e5a1ea14d3910a126a2027903: bytes replaced by a different file with the same name

expect.report: digest mismatch for the referenced version

steps.action: any automatic deletion or in-place repair

durableEffects: the tampered bytes are retained byte-for-byte in place
observations: every read verifies the digest before the bytes are handed to a renderer/importer (content addressing makes this cheap and mandatory)
a symlinked sources/ path or artifact directory is refused (path_rejected) rather than followed
an external-source tamper can therefore never silently change rendered or exported content

notes: A10: source tampering is detected and source backup/restore retains playable content.
